Sam (CSM): Starting a quick thread for Vireo Health QBR prep. Top asks: day-by-day 60d burn, two cost scenarios (embed spike + steady growth), and a short enablement playbook.
Ivy (FinOps): Need baseline $/mo, committed credits remaining, and a suggested soft/hard alerting policy. Recommend soft at +25% vs baseline, hard at +50% or credits <12%.
Cal (Data): Will pull 90d daily split by feature & model. SQL I'll run: `SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) d, feature, SUM(tokens) t FROM usage WHERE account='vireo' AND ts >= now()-interval '90 days' GROUP BY d, feature ORDER BY d;` ETA ~2h.
Rae (AM): FYI customer plans to roll similarity search next week. Expect embeddings to rise. They want a "safe rollout" checklist.
Sam (CSM): For deck: slide1 current burn & model mix, slide2 scenario A: 2x embed for 30d, slide3 scenario B: 6% QoQ growth, slide4 alert/runbook + enablement one-pager.
Ivy (FinOps): I'll draft the ops one-pager: quick wins = batch size increase, enable prefix caching, lower-dim embeddings option, and an autoscale throttle for embeds. Will post by EOD.
Cal (Data): Raw last30d: gen=51,200,000 tokens, embed=21,400,000 tokens. Uploading CSV to /shared/qbr/vireo_tokens.csv now.
qbr-bot: CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/vireo_tokens.csv  baseline forecast (+10%) appended.
Sam (CSM): @Cal can you run the two forecast variants and map tokens->dollars using model mix: 70% gen @ $0.0006, 30% embed @ $0.0012? Need explicit $ for slides.
Cal (Data): Will output: day, tokens, $cost, runway months given current credits. ETA 90m.
Rae (AM): I'll coordinate a 45-min enablement session (30m demo + 15m Q&A) covering batching, KV/prefix caching, and a brief checklist. Tentatively Thurs 10am PT.
Ivy (FinOps): Monitoring config created in staging: `alerts/vireo/budget`. I'll add `snooze_window` for the enablement slot and a manual override tag for approved spikes.
Sam (CSM): Action items: Cal (forecasts + CSV), Ivy (one-pager + monitor + playbook), Rae (confirm session), Sam (assemble deck). I'll share draft slides by tomorrow 9am PT. Ping me for blockers.
qbr-bot: QBR checklist updated: "Vireo Health cost scenarios + enablement" assigned to Sam, due in 12 hours.
